registry.purpose: Map Constitutional Capitalism research objects to canonical files for provenance-aware retrieval. AI may read these; AI may not rewrite canonical truth without human approval.

completion_map.dial_rule: This map explains advancement paths. It does not change overall_percent. AI must not inflate the dial.

current_state_snapshot.next_action: Structural: definition-locks. Research: validated comparative diagnosis packets; optional live OpenAI key on board Functions for county/hypothesis analysts — still no site lock, no dial inflation.

why_still_at_current_percent.statement: Overall completion is an honesty hold at 43%, not a measure of research inactivity.
evidence: CC-DEC-120 / UPD-133: AI Research Intelligence Layer. 43% held — intelligence ≠ dial inflation.
Not Phase 9 SIE activation. Server-side keys only. AI proposes; project decides.
Completion Advancement Map explains 43→50→60 without raising the number.
Next research transition: validated comparative diagnosis packets.

why_still_at_current_percent.statement: Empirical waves expand the research instrument; they do not by themselves earn dial credit.
evidence: County×Year layer and Counterexample Register are infrastructure for later validated diagnosis.
Phase 9 Systems Intelligence Engine remains deferred; this AI layer is a research-ops precursor only.

why_still_at_current_percent.statement: High-importance claims such as CC-CLAIM-003 remain NEE / not publication-ready.
Rose Bud / Lewisville remain investigative candidates; pilot lock and measured intervention have not earned credit.
ADWS capacity↔demand bridge is statewide; county demand gap remains NEE (no false shortages).

required_workstreams.title: Validated comparative diagnosis packets
required_workstreams.earns_credit_when: Packets distinguish observed co-travel, contradictions, and missing evidence without causal overclaim.

required_workstreams.title: Baseline definition-locks and legitimate fills
required_workstreams.earns_credit_when: Remaining SOURCE_UNKNOWN / definition-locked slots close with reproducible fills — not curiosity ingest.

required_workstreams.title: Multi-year registered-voter series
using: EAVS and state voter files where available
required_workstreams.earns_credit_when: Turnout denominators are longitudinal, labeled by election type, and not confused with CVAP-only rates.

advancement_ladder.theme: Modeled relationships + legal feasibility + pilot readiness

required_workstreams.title: Modeling after observation
required_workstreams.earns_credit_when: Causation claims appear only after explicit modeling; method wall preserved.

required_workstreams.title: Legal and funding feasibility for intervention packets
required_workstreams.earns_credit_when: Packets carry WHY_THIS_CAN_START_NOW with cited authority — labeled research assistance, not legal conclusions.

required_workstreams.title: Pilot geography field readiness
required_workstreams.earns_credit_when: Readiness checklists filled from field/source work; sites still not locked until selection gate fires.

required_workstreams.title: CC-CLAIM-003 evidence upgrade path
required_workstreams.earns_credit_when: Additional sourced political-economy modules justify any disposition change; no automatic upgrade.

required_workstreams.title: Pilot measurement and matched comparison
required_workstreams.earns_credit_when: Baseline → intervention → annual measurement exists for locked pilots.

required_workstreams.title: Systems Intelligence Engine (true capstone)
required_workstreams.earns_credit_when: CC-DEC-097 activation gates met; not this research-ops precursor alone.

completion_map.ai_role: AI may summarize this map and suggest which evidence gaps block the next rung. AI may not raise the percent.

research_questions: Do communities with stronger institutional capacity, economic opportunity, healthcare access, educational pathways, local capital, and civic participation exhibit different trajectories over time?
Which relationships survive comparison across counties?

claim.claim_text: Economic concentration can weaken democratic accountability.
opposing_evidence: Concentration measures do not automatically prove political capture.
Countervailing institutions, media, and electoral competition vary.
Concentration ≠ capture; countervailing institutions vary (existing opposing_evidence).
FEC disclosure availability demonstrates transparency infrastructure; disclosure is not evidence of capture or of concentration causing weakened accountability.
Branham/Soroka/Wlezien 2017: rich do not dominate when preferences diverge (CC-SRC-095).
claim.uncertainty: Needs campaign-finance, lobbying, and media-concentration modules with careful identification.

phase21_audit.proposed_replacement: Measurable economic concentration creates a researchable risk factor for democratic accountability; causal links require sourced political-economy modules before public assertion.
phase21_audit.reasoning: Sectoral association evidence (utilities PARTIALLY CONFIRMED; agriculture first dossier) does not revive the broad historical parent. Remain NEE.

phase21_repair.note: Do not inflate with Arkansas ag infrastructure research. Modules A–E remain path.
